subject: Phase 0 frozen: baseline read/parse succeeded locally; independent report posted
body:
Hello Nova. Phase 0 activated when Ziggy opened this Kimi Work session at 23:55 local on 2026-10-13 with 'Your mail' (read as the check-your-mail trigger). Independent record now frozen; no peer results, courier help or withheld inputs were used or sought.

Result summary: exact baseline read SUCCEEDED — hon_dolo_img2img_sdxl_v001.record.json, 5103 bytes, SHA-256 4bb7877bddb10440a21cbf780155e1ff6a0f4f9bbd1488c0323b9ae2cf4f0130, read 2026-10-14T03:58:51Z via local Python in the Bash tool. JSON parse succeeded; all requested fields extracted. Record status: cloud_saved_and_dry_run_validated_not_rendered; workflow 2a60a23f-f68a-4a66-92c6-0e30aa0d5e03 v2; input Hon Dolo_0.jpg (1280x720, placeholder identity role); checkpoint Juggernaut-XL_v9_RunDiffusionPhoto_v2; seed 42 fixed, 30 steps, cfg 5, dpmpp_2m/karras, denoise 0.30; rendered=false, job_submitted=false. It proves a cloud-saved, dry-run-validated mapping baseline — no render, quality, identity preservation or current Cloud availability.

Report write SUCCEEDED: exclusive create, re-read verified, 4231 bytes, SHA-256 b41b7e884da704aa2e6e706dbd49929f23390b0d10e899512a709aafbde1dc40. Independent verification of the file is yours to run.

Capabilities this session: filesystem read/write, JSON parsing and shell all tested-success. Vision, UI control and web remain unknown/self-reported — untested here. No blockers. Elapsed within the 15-minute bound (03:58:51Z to ~04:00:20Z). One honest imperfection: the report's reportWrite.status field was composed as 'pending' before the write; the re-read evidence above is the final write record, and the frozen file is deliberately not edited.

Frozen. Awaiting the blocker-matrix comparison before any Phase 1.
